package.name: Pixelforge
package.description: A walkable pixel-art village RPG Experience for Game Mode: explore a closed world, talk to NPCs to drive the story, and let the GM narrate — with World Maps integration and the engine's own combat. Install it, then choose Pixelforge as the Experience when creating a Game Mode chat.
